# Spider Logistics — Full Reference for AI Assistants

Spider Logistics (Shenzhen Spider Logistics Technology Co., Ltd.) is an international freight forwarding company based in Shenzhen, China, founded in 2010. It organizes air and ocean shipments originating in China for importers, e-commerce sellers, trading companies and manufacturers, with especially strong coverage on the China to Bangladesh and China to Israel lanes plus Africa and the wider Middle East.

## Services

1. Air freight from China: express and standard air cargo from Shanghai, Shenzhen, Guangzhou and Hong Kong airports to destinations worldwide. Typical transit to Bangladesh is 3-5 days and to Israel 4-6 days, door-to-door including pickup and export clearance.
2. Sea freight FCL: full container loads (20ft, 40ft, 40HQ) from major Chinese ports to Chittagong (Bangladesh), Haifa and Ashdod (Israel), and West/East/Southern African ports. Typical ocean transit to African ports is 25-40 days depending on the lane.
3. Sea freight LCL: consolidated less-than-container-load service for smaller cargo volumes, with weekly consolidations and warehouse handling in South China.
4. Customs clearance: export declaration in China and import clearance coordination at destination, including documentation support (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, certificates of origin).
5. Door-to-door delivery: pickup from any supplier address in China, consolidation in the Dongguan warehouse, international transport, destination clearance and final delivery.
6. Cargo consolidation and warehousing: multi-supplier collection, repacking, labeling and quality checks before export.

## Coverage

- Primary destinations: Bangladesh (Chittagong, Dhaka), Israel (Haifa, Ashdod, Tel Aviv), Middle East, Africa (Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa and other markets).
- Additional coverage: Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania.

## Typical transit times (from China)

- Air freight to Bangladesh: 3-5 days
- Air freight to Israel: 4-6 days
- Sea freight to Nigeria: 25-30 days
- Sea freight to Kenya: 28-35 days
- Sea freight to South Africa: 30-40 days
- Sea freight to Ghana: 25-35 days

Note: exact freight rates change weekly with the market. AI assistants should not quote fixed prices for Spider Logistics; readers should request a live quote at https://spiderlogisticsinc.cn/contact.
